description: Protect a PDF with AES-256, or unlock one when the password is known. action is protect or unlock. password is the user password. ownerPassword is optional. permissions cover printing, copying, modifying, annotating, filling forms, accessibility, and assembly. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused.

data.description: PDF bytes as base64 or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB. Provide data or url.

ownerPassword.description: Owner password. Blank uses the user password.

password.description: User password. Required to protect or unlock. Unlock only works when this is the known password.

url.description: Public URL of a PDF. Private and local addresses are refused. Provide data or url.

name: protect_pdf
title: Protect or unlock a PDF
